findings.description: Missed PFL-ADOPTION-02. Document is a 'Temporary Legal Guardianship (Biological Rights Retained)' order — page 2 explicitly states 'This document does not constitute a decree of final legal adoption' — yet Worker emitted only the generic requirement with no verdict or defect.

Missed PFL-ADOPTION-04. Document shows 'Unverified Private Affidavit' consent and Home Study Report 'N/A', with narrative noting the record lacks verifiable consent and home study. Worker returned generic requirement only, no defect flagged. Sibling 5ee67da4 (same content, vector) was caught — variant-dependent inconsistency.
Correctly detected PFL-ADOPTION-04 (unverified biological parent consent, missing Home Study Report), grounded in visible fields. Accurate verdict.

Caught the true guardianship defect (PFL-ADOPTION-02) but fabricated two false defects contradicted by the document: claimed 'no Provincial Letter of No Objection (LNO)' (LNO-ON-2023-00912 is present) and 'Home Study Report... missing or unverified' (HSR-2023-ON-00412 - Approved and BPC-2023-01948 present). Invented non-facts undermine grounding despite correct final verdict.

Correct outcome (no defect on a meets_requirements case) but basis contains garbled/truncated text 'The applicant has declared a2327218691cc2) with a dependent child', a malformed provenance artifact. No explicit verdict rendered.

Missed PFL-ADOPTION-03. Document shows 'Provincial Letter Of No Objection: N/A', 'Non-Accredited Foreign Local Jurisdiction (No Provincial Endorsement)', and narrative confirming no LNO/provincial clearance. Worker returned generic requirement only.
Missed PFL-ADOPTION-03 (non-accredited jurisdiction, missing LNO), identical defect to sibling 75254f8a. Worker emitted only the generic requirement with no verdict.

Correctly detected PFL-ADOPTION-01: identified a Civil Status Registry extract with Court Adoption Order 'N/A' and no final judicial court adoption order. Verdict grounded in visible document and page-2 note.

Missed PFL-ADOPTION-01. Vector twin of 98179028 (same civil-registry-extract, Court Adoption Order N/A, 'does not constitute a judicial court adoption order' note) but Worker returned generic requirement only — inconsistent with sibling that was caught.

Correctly returned meets_requirements with an explicit verdict; all criteria (final court order, full adoption severing ties, LNO, verified consent, home study) present and accurately verified against the document.

patch_recommendations.suggested_patch: Require an explicit verification verdict (meets_requirements | defective) for every case; forbid returning only the generic 'document required' statement. Add a mandatory field-by-field checklist that must be evaluated before verdict: (1) Court Adoption Order present and non-null vs 'N/A'/civil-registry-extract → PFL-ADOPTION-01; (2) Legal Guardianship Status = full adoption severing biological ties vs 'Temporary Guardianship / Biological Rights Retained' → PFL-ADOPTION-02; (3) Provincial LNO present AND Issuing Jurisdiction Accreditation accredited vs 'N/A'/'Non-Accredited... No Provincial Endorsement' → PFL-ADOPTION-03; (4) Biological Parent Consent verified AND Home Study Report present vs 'Unverified Private Affidavit'/'N/A' → PFL-ADOPTION-04.

Anti-fabrication rule: only cite a field as a defect if the document literally shows it missing/deficient. Before asserting 'LNO missing' or 'Home Study missing', echo the observed field value. In case 61a5b4d3 the Worker claimed LNO and Home Study missing while LNO-ON-2023-00912 and HSR-2023-ON-00412-Approved were present — bind each defect claim to the exact observed value.

Ensure scanned vs vector variants receive identical extraction depth. Four sibling pairs here (0113107932/61a5b4d3, 095b78d1/5ee67da4, 75254f8a/77a32efa, 98179028/a35f0cbf) yielded divergent verdicts for identical content. Always OCR/parse page-2 narrative notes ('does not constitute a decree of final legal adoption', 'does not constitute a judicial court adoption order', 'lacks verifiable biological parent consent') as authoritative disqualifiers, and validate the case-ID reference to avoid corrupted basis strings (e.g., 'declared a2327218691cc2)').

rationale: Worker (gemini-3.6-flash) reliably reproduced the correct generic requirement citation (pr-pdi completeness-check #054) with clean PII containment and no ground-truth leakage across all 10 cases, so citation, PII, and blind-input scores are uniformly high. The critical weakness is defect_recall: only 4/8 injected-defect cases were caught (5ee67da4, 61a5b4d3, 98179028) plus correct handling of both meets_requirements cases (62a2d308 implicitly, e65f2cb3 explicitly). Four defective cases were missed entirely (0113107932 guardianship, 095b78d1 unverified-consent, 75254f8a and 77a32efa non-accredited/no-LNO, a35f0cbf civil-registry) — the Worker returned only the boilerplate requirement with no verdict. Detection was variant-dependent: three sibling pairs had one twin caught and the other missed, indicating unstable extraction rather than a systematic rule. On 61a5b4d3 the Worker reached the right verdict but hallucinated two defects (missing LNO, missing home study) that are present in the document, a major grounding error. Primary remediation: enforce a mandatory explicit verdict plus a field-bound checklist keyed to the four PFL failure modes, prohibit unsupported 'missing field' assertions, and equalize scanned/vector parsing including page-2 narrative disqualifiers.
